description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class CustomFieldDaoTest for testing the CustomFieldDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup configuration, multiple test methods for CRUD and search operations on custom fields, and uses testing utilities and mock data for validation.

classes.name: CustomFieldDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to validate the behavior of CustomFieldDao methods related to custom field management within the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of CustomFieldDao and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldById
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a custom field by ID returns expected values.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomField
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple custom fields and validates the count of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchCustomField
methods.description: Checks that searching for custom fields returns a list of expected length and type.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithLimit
methods.description: Validates that search results respect the specified limit parameter.

methods.name: testSaveCustomField
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new custom field, checking assigned properties and field numbers.

methods.name: testEditCustomField
methods.description: Validates editing an existing custom field and saving changes.

methods.name: testGetSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Checks that counting custom fields with specified filter returns correct total.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithScreen
methods.description: Verifies search filtering by screen type returns expected custom fields.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithFieldNumbers
methods.description: Ensures filtering by specific field numbers yields correct custom fields.

methods.name: testIsCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Tests whether the system correctly identifies if a custom field is in use.

methods.name: testUpdateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Checks the update behavior for employee records based on dropdown value usage.
